Lina (Sales): Quick ask - Vertex wants a live demo POC next Thurs. They need a hosted key with a short high-throughput window (demo) + a lower sustained rate for smoke testing. Can infra provision?
Omar (Infra): What peak and sustained numbers are we talking?
Lina (Sales): Peak ~420 rps for 15 minutes, sustained 60 rps for 3 hours. Mostly short prompts, streaming SSE required.
Diego (Platform): Streaming + high burst is doable via an ephemeral scoped key. Need IP allowlist or a proxy.
Priya (Security): We require: server-side calls from fixed egress IPs, key TTL <= 72h, scope limited to text generation only, redact logs, and customer's security contact.
Lina (Sales): They can egress from 34.120.44.0/24 and 34.120.45.0/24. TTL okay at 48h. Contact: secops@vertex.ai.
Omar (Infra): I'll create an override: burst_rate=420 rps for 15m, sustain_rate=60 rps thereafter until end_time. Increase concurrent streaming connections for this key to 120.
Riley (SRE): I'll add monitoring; alert to #eng-oncall if error_rate > 3% or p95 latency > 1.2s. Also will set a dashboard.
Diego (Platform): Confirm key scope locked to generation:invoke, embeddings and rerank disabled. Logs redaction enabled, full token traces off.
Priya (Security): Also require that we disable export of raw payloads; limited logs retained 5 days.
Lina (Sales): Demo window: 2028-05-05T15:00:00Z to 2028-05-05T19:00:00Z. Prep/test window beforehand 2028-05-05T13:00:00Z to 14:30:00Z.
Omar (Infra): Noted. Need a ticket with IPs + exact windows. I'll post the ephemeral key to the ticket once ready.
Lina (Sales): Ticket created: REDWOOD-POC-492. Please include curl examples.
(20 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Ephemeral key provisioned: id ephem_b7c2d, scope=generation:invoke, expires in 48h, IP allowlist applied. Details in REDWOOD-POC-492.
Omar (Infra): Sample curl (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"recommendations for user 123"}],"stream":true}'
```
Omar (Infra): Note: long-lived SSE connections expected; we upped connection limit and tuned timeouts for this key.
Lina (Sales): Forwarding to Vertex now. They asked: if they sustain 60 rps for a month, what's the rough cost?
Diego (Platform): Ballpark: ~ $1.8k/mo for continuous 60 rps on rw-gpt-7b under current token assumptions. Will draft a formal quote.
Priya (Security): Reviewed ticket - OK to proceed. Ensure customer uses the allowed IP ranges only.
Riley (SRE): Monitoring and alerts in place. I'll watch the channel during the live demo window.
Vertex (customer via email): Received key, smoke test shows ~400 rps with streaming and no errors.
Lina (Sales): Great news. Ping me if anything spikes outside the window.
Omar (Infra): Automatic fallback configured: if sustained load > 60 rps outside demo, route to rw-gpt-3.5-medium with lower token limits.
Lina (Sales): Thanks all :raised_hands:
